voice.persona: warm male supervisor, mid-30s, neutral Gulf-English accent

segments.narration: Every accurate stock count starts at the dock. [[pause:0.5]] In this module, you'll learn how to receive finished goods, and get them into SAP the right way.

Goods reach us from three places. [[cue:plant]] Our own plants, [[cue:truck]] sales trucks returning from their routes, [[cue:supplier]] and outside suppliers. Each one has its own checks, so explore all three.
segments.on_screen_text: Three ways goods arrive. Select each one.

segments.narration: When a shuttle arrives from the plant, [[cue:check]] first compare the goods with the delivery note. [[cue:offload]] If everything matches, offload to bulk storage. [[cue:sign]] Then sign and stamp the note for the driver. [[cue:post]] Finally, post the receipt in SAP using MIGO.
segments.on_screen_text: Check → Offload → Sign & stamp → Post in SAP

segments.narration: Here's a situation you'll meet sooner or later. [[pause:0.5]] One pallet arrives damaged. What would you do?
